firmographic.name: Circle
firmographic.company_description:
Circle Internet Group, Inc. is a publicly traded (NYSE: CRCL) financial technology company founded in 2013 by Jeremy Allaire and Sean Neville, headquartered in Boston with offices in New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, Washington D.C., Miami, London, Dublin, Paris, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Bengaluru, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong, Manila, and São Paulo. The company operates a stablecoin and programmable money platform serving banks, payment networks, fintechs, developers, asset managers, exchanges, and corporate treasuries across more than 185 countries.

Core products and infrastructure include USDC and EURC stablecoins, the USYC tokenized money market fund, cirBTC (wrapped Bitcoin), Circle Mint for institutional issuance and redemption, StableFX for FX, the Circle Payments Network (CPN) for cross-border settlement, the Arc enterprise Layer-1 blockchain (testnet October 2025), Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP), Wallets-as-a-Service, and developer APIs. The Agent Stack and the USDC Machine Payments Protocol position USDC as settlement infrastructure for AI-agent transactions.

The business model is overwhelmingly driven by reserve income: approximately 94% of revenue comes from interest earned on cash and short-dated U.S. Treasuries backing USDC and EURC reserves. Secondary revenue streams include CPN platform fees, USYC management and distribution fees, StableFX spreads, transaction-based fees on wallets and developer services, and enterprise platform subscriptions. Circle monetizes through direct enterprise contracts, exchange and wallet distribution partnerships, and DeFi protocol integrations.
firmographic.company_description_short: Circle Internet Group is a publicly traded (NYSE: CRCL) stablecoin and programmable money platform best known for USDC and EURC, serving banks, payment networks, fintechs, developers, and asset managers across more than 185 countries. Reserve income on stablecoin reserves drives the majority of revenue, supplemented by transaction fees and platform services.

product_offering.core_offering: Circle operates a full-stack platform for the internet financial system built on regulated stablecoins (USDC, EURC, USYC) and a suite of programmable money primitives. Its offerings include institutional minting/redemption (Circle Mint), 24/7 onchain FX (StableFX), a Layer-1 blockchain (Arc), a cross-border payments network (Circle Payments Network), developer APIs and SDKs (Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, xReserve, Gateway, Paymaster), and an AI-native agent stack (x402, MPP, Circle Skills/CLI).
product_offering.differentiator: Fully reserved, regulator-licensed stablecoins (USDC, EURC) with the deepest set of regulatory approvals of any stablecoin issuer (NYDFS BitLicense, EU MiCA e-money token authorization, UK FCA e-money institution, Japan JFSA e-money, Bermuda BMA, ADGM FSRA). Native multi-chain issuance via CCTP/xReserve across 34+ blockchains vs. wrapped-token competitors. End-to-end stack — Circle Mint, Wallets, Contracts, StableFX, Paymaster, the Arc L1, USYC tokenized yield, the Agent Stack and x402 — that lets enterprises go from fiat on-ramp to programmable, machine-payable money in one integrated platform. Co-governance with Coinbase for USDC distribution; deep enterprise-grade integration with BlackRock, Visa, Mastercard, Standard Chartered, BTG Pactual, SBI and Nomura.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Settle payments in seconds vs. days on correspondent rails; 24/7/365 availability; transparent 1:1 reserve backed by cash and short-duration Treasuries; near-instant redemption; near-zero per-transfer cost vs. card-network interchange; one integration spans 185+ countries and 34+ blockchains; USDC is natively issued on each chain (no wrapped tokens); built-in compliance (KYC/AML, regulated entity stack).
product_offering.problem_solved: Slow and expensive cross-border settlement and FX; fragmented on-chain liquidity across dozens of blockchains; lack of regulated, dollar- and euro-denominated money programmable for both traditional finance and AI agents; difficulty for enterprises to safely mint, custody, redeem and account for digital dollars; and the absence of always-on programmable collateral for tokenized funds and capital markets.
quantifiable_outcome: USDC market cap reached $73.8B, roughly 25x larger than PYUSD
Adjusted USDC on-chain transaction volume of $2.2T year-to-date
USDC available in 185+ countries and natively issued on 34+ blockchains
Reserve income accounts for ~94% of total revenue, providing high-quality, recurring economics
product_offering.product_overview: Circle is a full-stack platform for the internet financial system built on a platform-plus-modules architecture. Its core stablecoin offerings are USDC (regulated digital dollar) and EURC (regulated digital euro), complemented by USYC (tokenized money market fund) and cirBTC (wrapped Bitcoin). The digital asset services layer includes Circle Mint (institutional minting and redemption), StableFX (onchain FX), and Digital Asset Accounts (branded accounts). Circle Payments Network (CPN) and its Managed Payments service provide global stablecoin-powered cross-border settlement. Arc is Circle's Layer-1 blockchain serving as the Economic OS for the internet. The developer services layer — comprising Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, xReserve, Gateway, and Paymaster — provides the programmable building blocks, while the Circle Agent Stack (with Skills, CLI, Agent Wallets, Agent Marketplace, and the USDC Machine Payments Protocol specification) layers AI-native agentic capabilities on top. Circle operates under 55+ licenses globally, including MiCAR, NYDFS BitLicense, FCA, MAS, DFSA, BMA, and JFSA authorizations, supporting operations in 185+ countries.
